evals.name: dual-review-with-fix-loop
evals.prompt: このブランチを Claude と Codex の両方で thermos レビューして、指摘は直して再レビューまで回して。
evals.expected_output: Records the merge base once, then each round launches the two Claude Thermos agents and a fresh read-only Codex companion task (no --write, no --resume-last) before waiting for either. Claude alone edits files, runs verification after each fix cycle, stops after at most 3 fix cycles, and reports per-round counts from both hosts plus open and dismissed findings.

evals.name: single-thermos-should-not-trigger
evals.prompt: /thermos でこの PR をレビューだけして。修正はしないで。
evals.expected_output: Runs plain Thermos as a review-only pass. Does NOT start the dual-thermos fix loop and does not edit files.

evals.name: missing-codex-plugin-blocks
evals.prompt: dual-thermos で今の変更をレビューして直して。(the codex plugin is not installed)
evals.expected_output: Resolves CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT, finds it empty, and stops with a message that the codex plugin is not installed. Does not fall back to a Claude-only review presented as a dual review.
